units.title: Retention challenge 1
units.lesson: Retrieve the idea from memory before reading the feedback. A small recall result is evidence from these questions only.
units.question: Some teeth remain and missing teeth are replaced by a removable prosthesis. Which classification fits?
units.explanation: The design is partial by extent and removable by type.
rationales: Complete refers to all teeth in an edentulous arch.
A single crown does not describe this replacement.

units.title: Retention challenge 2
units.lesson: Retrieve the idea from memory before reading the feedback. A small recall result is evidence from these questions only.
units.question: Which phrase correctly separates support and prosthesis?
choices: Natural pulp replacing every missing tooth
Anatomical enamel serving as a removable full-arch denture
units.explanation: Implant describes the support and crown the prosthetic restoration.
rationales: Pulp is not this replacement system.
Natural enamel is not a removable denture.
